response.justification: Bogdan brings 14+ years of hands-on software development with unusually strong developer-tooling credentials — he authored a D test runner (Trial) and assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built CI/CD and device-orchestration infrastructure, worked on an IDE at National Instruments, and has taught testing/automation courses. That easily clears the technical and developer-tools bars. However, the role is a people-leadership position (Level II Manager), and the resume shows no evidence of formal people management: no direct reports, no hiring, no performance reviews, no team-lead or EM titles. Staff Engineer and founder roles imply technical influence and possibly informal mentorship, but the 2-year people-management minimum and preferred organizational-change experience are unsubstantiated. Mobile-platform exposure exists (iOS/Apple TV, mobile device orchestration) but is dated and secondary. Worth a screening call to probe leadership scope, but he currently reads as a strong senior/staff IC candidate rather than a manager.
strengths: Deep, authentic developer-tools and test-infrastructure portfolio (test runner, assertion lib, CI/CD, IDE work)
14+ years across web, mobile, desktop and embedded; broad system-design and polyglot depth
Proven knowledge-sharing: workshops, multi-module Selenium course, conference talks, dojos
concerns: No documented people-management experience — misses a hard 2-year minimum
No evidence of roadmap ownership, performance management, or leading organizational change
Mobile-platform experience is limited and roughly a decade old; ecosystem is Node/D/TS-centric, not Android/mobile-platform scale

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure depth
